intro: The Snowflake table transform your dining space into a haven of everyday luxury. Designed with a marble top and solid wood legs, it blends strength and elegance to host meals and memories alike​.

features.title: Marble top with lasting strength
features.text: You’ll love how easy life feels with this natural marble tabletop. Laminated with a protective coating, it offers the durability you need and effortless maintenance for everyday use.

features.title: Enhanced wood support
features.text: We built this to stand the test of time. Solid rubberwood legs provide the strength and stability your everyday dining deserves.

features.title: Elegant walnut frame
features.text: Style meets contrast—the walnut-coloured wooden frame and marble top create a stunning focal point in your dining area.

features.title: Stain-resistant finish
features.text: No-fuss cleaning—stain-resistant surfaces mean you can spend less time scrubbing and more time enjoying meals.

features.title: Sophisticated design
features.text: Combining modern elegance with everyday durability, this table elevates your dining room while standing up to daily use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
